kinds.flagship: Measurement route with a Sentinel scorer, taken to live end-to-end proof first.
kinds.guided: Workflow route for cost, packaging, or the decision record; not a measurement route.
kinds.preview: Measurement route with a full workflow but less evidence; no Sentinel scorer yet.
kinds.router: Front door that picks the route when the user is unsure which one fits.
kinds.utility: Setup, connection, status, or feedback helper around the delivery loop.
